(c) The fire damage in room units varied because of the different distributions of combustible items to be ignited after window glass fallout during re-entrant fires.

(d) It shows a sequence of fully developed fires at adjacent floors, which may due to the unfortunate ignition of living rooms, or the secondary spreading along the building façade. The ejecting flames of one unit reignited the remained façade scaffolding and caused fire spread to upper floors.
